title: Review MM-07 through MM-10 operational and policy acceptance
steps: Review MM-07 provenance/moderation, MM-08 Canon, MM-09 online protocol and MM-10 governance specs, plans and tasks.
Run deterministic negative, replay, protocol and policy-document checks.
Identify the remaining privacy, abuse-safety, operator, hosting, identity, retention, public-contact, licensing and moderation decisions.
Assign explicit owners and evidence actions for each external gate without claiming hosted service or public-release readiness.
Defer non-critical implementation errors to a follow-up backlog so they do not block independent PR review.
acceptance: MM-07 through MM-10 have reconciled evidence and explicit external acceptance actions; no pending operational or policy gate is silently marked complete.
